bounded SessionCatalogSnapshot discovery of the probe session through IPC
generation-scoped SessionVolumeCommand through IPC, EngineControl queue and COM worker
temporary approximately −3 dB session attenuation and readback
original session dB and mute restoration before probe exit

limitations: This is an explicitly user-invoked user-space Engine Preview IPC/control-queue/COM-worker probe against a temporary silent session; it proves the route graph control transaction but does not prove a Hibiki virtual endpoint, physical per-App capture/re-send, DSP lane delivery, WaveRT/PortCls, HLK or Microsoft signing.
The probe temporarily changes only its own test session volume and must never be run implicitly by CI or application startup.
The local machine is Windows 26200/Visual Studio 17 with SDK 26100, below the locked Windows 11 24H2/VS 2026/WDK target.
